description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) by delegating to a chain of LogNode instances. It encapsulates logging configuration and provides a simplified interface for Android logging.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, delegating to LogNode instances, and managing log configurations.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode at the head of the log chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to be used for logging.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.
